package.name: flux_bridge
package.description: Republishes flux channels as DDS topics so stock ROS 2 tools (ros2 bag, rqt, ros2 topic) can read them. Lazy: a channel is relayed only while a ROS 2 subscriber for its name exists. Ships ros2 topic echo_flux / hz_flux and ros2 bag record_flux, which create that subscriber before running the stock verb.
